name: Resequence: The Orchard
source:
Resequence: The Orchard is a multi-perspective occult-horror adventure game about an otherworldly presence slowly eroding everyday life.

Feeling extremely hard to move on after his wife’s missing and drained of the will to live, Kisuke Saito—encouraged by his colleague Aislinn and a high school girl Kaneko Honda—accepted the job as a school counselor. But every student who comes to him is plagued by inexplicable phenomena…

Players would play the role of Kisuke Saito and uncover the students’ past by hearing their experiences. Reveal the truth of his wife’s missing and eventually bring out what lies beneath the record—what’s haunted “there”.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4102120/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
Resequence: The Orchard是一款多视角的神秘恐怖冒险游戏，讲述了一个超凡脱俗的存在慢慢侵蚀日常生活的故事。

妻子失踪后，齐藤喜介感到自己的生活变得极其艰难，活下去的意愿也被耗尽，他在同事艾斯林和高中女生本多金子的鼓励下接受了学校辅导员的工作。但每一个来到他身边的学生都被莫名其妙的现象所困扰……

玩家将扮演斋藤喜介的角色，通过聆听学生们的经历来揭开他们的过去。揭露他妻子失踪的真相，并最终查出记录下隐藏的真相——“那里”闹鬼的事情。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4102120/]Steam[/url]]
